newsitem.title: USA: PremiumWear stake lifted by Houston group.
newsitem.headline: PremiumWear stake lifted by Houston group.

text.p: A group led by Francisco Lorenzo, chairman of Savoy Partners Inc, a private investment banking company in Houston, said Tuesday it raised its stake in PremiumWear Inc to 184,100 common shares, or 7.9 percent, from 6.83 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 38,500 common shares between February 13 and March 17 at prices ranging from $3.125 to $8.875 per share.
PremiumWear markets Munsingwear brand knit shirts and other apparel items to premium and special market industries under a license from Supreme International Corp.
